# Plugins Install

## Rules
- `specd plugins install <plugin> [<plugin>...]`; one+ npm package names.
- Declaration source: loaded `SpecdConfig.plugins`; already-installed detection via `config.plugins.agents` or appropriate type bucket. Config snapshot available → never `kernel.project.listPlugins` / `ConfigWriter.listPlugins`.
- Tabular output header `Installed plugins:` then newline-separated details.
- Already declared: warning containing `already installed` before `update`; SHOULD suggest update reinstall; skip installation.
- Each undeclared plugin: call `InstallPlugin` from `@specd/plugin-manager`; success → `createConfigWriter().addPlugin(configPath, type, name, config)`; failure → emit error, continue remaining plugins.
- Never `kernel.project.addPlugin`; SHOULD construct kernel only for subsequent required domain operations.
- Any install failure → exit 1 after processing all plugins.
- Output plugin name, status (`installed`, `skipped`, error message), additional details; `--format json` machine-parseable.

## Constraints
- Already installed → no specd.yaml mutation.
- Validate plugin names before installation.
